---
title: "Stage 4: Build controls – density, unemployment"
---

```{r}
#| label: purpose
#| include: false
# =============================================================================
# Purpose : Build a city-year control panel for the recall-active cities
#           across 2014-2024.
#
# Sources :
#   Population density  – Census Population Estimates Program (PEP) via tidycensus
#                         True annual estimates (not 5-year smoothed). Combined
#                         from Vintage 2019 (years 2014-2019) + Vintage 2024
#                         (years 2020-2024).
#                         land area: tigris::places() ALAND attribute (sq mi)
#   Unemployment        – BLS LAUS flat file `la.data.64.County`
#                         (annual averages, period M13; county-level)
#
# Inputs  : data/cleaned/recalls_clean.rds
# Outputs : data/cleaned/controls.rds       (city × year × controls)
# =============================================================================
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(tigris)
library(here)
library(httr2)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
here::i_am("_quarto.yml")
source(here("R", "std_city.R"))

recalls <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned", "recalls_clean.rds"))

cities <- recalls |>
  distinct(city_id, city, city_std, state, state_std) |>
  mutate(state_abb = state.abb[match(state, state.name)],
         state_abb = if_else(state == "District of Columbia", "DC", state_abb))

cat("Cities to build controls for:", nrow(cities), "across",
    n_distinct(cities$state), "states\n")
```

## Part A – Population (Census PEP, true annual)

```{r}
#| label: pep-fetch
#| cache: true
# PEP is published in vintages. Each vintage gives multiple years of annual
# estimates. Strategy: use Vintage 2019 for 2014-2019, Vintage 2024 for 2020-2024
# (V2024 supersedes earlier estimates for overlapping years). Combined: true
# annual estimates 2014-2024 – no 5-year smoothing.

target_states <- unique(cities$state_abb)

fetch_v19 <- function(st) {
  tryCatch({
    get_estimates(geography = "place", state = st, product = "population",
                  vintage = 2019, year = 2019, time_series = TRUE,
                  show_call = FALSE) |>
      filter(variable == "POP", DATE %in% 7:12) |>
      mutate(state_abb = st,
             acs_year  = 2014L + (DATE - 7L)) |>
      select(GEOID, NAME, state_abb, acs_year, pop = value)
  }, error = function(e) { message("V2019 ", st, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); tibble() })
}

fetch_v24 <- function(st) {
  tryCatch({
    get_estimates(geography = "place", state = st, variables = "POPESTIMATE",
                  vintage = 2024, time_series = TRUE,
                  show_call = FALSE) |>
      filter(year >= 2020, year <= 2024) |>
      mutate(state_abb = st) |>
      select(GEOID, NAME, state_abb, acs_year = year, pop = value)
  }, error = function(e) { message("V2024 ", st, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); tibble() })
}

acs_raw <- bind_rows(map_dfr(target_states, fetch_v19),
                     map_dfr(target_states, fetch_v24))

cat("PEP raw rows:", nrow(acs_raw),
    " | unique places:", n_distinct(acs_raw$GEOID),
    " | years:", paste(sort(unique(acs_raw$acs_year)), collapse=","), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: pep-parse
# Parse city name from PEP NAME field.
acs_parsed <- acs_raw |>
  mutate(
    place_name = NAME |> str_remove(",\\s*[A-Za-z ]+$"),
    city_std   = std_city(place_name),
    state_std  = cities$state_std[match(state_abb, cities$state_abb)]
  ) |>
  select(GEOID, place_name, city_std, state_abb, state_std, acs_year, pop)
```

```{r}
#| label: acs-land-area
#| cache: true
# Pull ALAND from tigris places() for BOTH 2020 and 2023 vintages.
# Reason: Census occasionally reclassifies places (e.g., Easthampton MA went from
# GEOID 2519370 "Easthampton Town city" in 2020 to 2519365 "Easthampton city" in
# 2023). PEP V2019 uses the old GEOID; V2024 uses the new one. Pulling both
# vintages ensures aland joins successfully regardless of vintage.
pull_aland <- function(yr) {
  target_states |>
    map_dfr(\(st) {
      tryCatch({
        places(state = st, year = yr, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
          as_tibble() |>
          transmute(GEOID = as.character(GEOID),
                    aland_sqmi = as.numeric(ALAND) / 2589988.11)
      }, error = function(e) { message("tigris ", yr, " ", st); tibble() })
    })
}

aland_2020 <- pull_aland(2020)
aland_2023 <- pull_aland(2023)
aland_2024 <- pull_aland(2024)

# Union, keeping one row per GEOID (most recent vintage wins where overlap)
aland <- bind_rows(aland_2024, aland_2023, aland_2020) |>
  group_by(GEOID) |> slice(1) |> ungroup()

cat("Land area rows: 2020 =", nrow(aland_2020),
    " | 2023 =", nrow(aland_2023),
    " | 2024 =", nrow(aland_2024),
    " | union =", nrow(aland), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: acs-density
density <- acs_parsed |>
  left_join(aland, by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(pop_density = pop / aland_sqmi)
```

```{r}
#| label: acs-match
# Match ACS places to recall cities on (city_std, state_std).
# One city_id may match multiple GEOIDs (e.g., "Springfield" in multiple counties)
# – resolve by picking the largest by population.
density_direct <- cities |>
  inner_join(density, by = c("city_std", "state_std"),
             relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  group_by(city_id, acs_year) |>
  slice_max(pop, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(city_id, year = acs_year, pop, pop_density, aland_sqmi, geoid = GEOID)

# Fuzzy fallback for cities that didn't match directly (e.g., "Boise" vs ACS's
# "Boise City"; townships and consolidated city-counties).
unmatched_cities <- cities |> anti_join(density_direct |> distinct(city_id), by = "city_id")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringdist))

# For each unmatched recall city, pick the nearest ACS place name within the
# same state (Jaro-Winkler >= 0.92). Map yields city_id → GEOID.
fuzzy_xwalk <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(unmatched_cities)), function(i) {
  rc <- unmatched_cities[i, ]
  pool <- density |> filter(state_std == rc$state_std) |>
                     distinct(GEOID, city_std)
  if (nrow(pool) == 0) return(tibble())
  scores <- 1 - stringdist::stringdist(rc$city_std, pool$city_std, method = "jw", p = 0.1)
  best <- which.max(scores)
  if (length(best) && scores[best] >= 0.92) {
    tibble(city_id = rc$city_id, geoid = pool$GEOID[best],
           match_score = scores[best])
  } else tibble()
})
cat("Fuzzy xwalk hits:", nrow(fuzzy_xwalk), "\n")

fuzzy_density <- fuzzy_xwalk |>
  inner_join(density |> rename(geoid = GEOID), by = "geoid") |>
  group_by(city_id, acs_year) |>
  slice_max(pop, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(city_id, year = acs_year, pop, pop_density, aland_sqmi, geoid)

density_matched <- bind_rows(density_direct, fuzzy_density)

# Third pass: cases where the recall-side standardizer over-stripped a
# trailing "City" that's actually part of the place's official name
# (Boise City, Kansas City, Oregon City, Traverse City, David City, Sioux
# City, etc.). Try matching the recall city_std with " city" appended.
unmatched3 <- cities |> anti_join(density_matched |> distinct(city_id), by = "city_id")
recover_city <- unmatched3 |>
  mutate(city_std = paste(city_std, "city")) |>           # mutate the join key
  inner_join(density, by = c("city_std", "state_std"),
             relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  group_by(city_id, acs_year) |>
  slice_max(pop, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(city_id, year = acs_year, pop, pop_density, aland_sqmi, geoid = GEOID)
cat("Recovery pass (' city' appended) hits:",
    n_distinct(recover_city$city_id), "cities\n")

# Fourth pass: hand-coded special cases (consolidated city-counties etc.)
manual_xwalk <- tribble(
  ~city_id,                  ~geoid,
  "nashville|tennessee",     "4752006"   # Nashville-Davidson metro govt (balance)
)
recover_manual <- manual_xwalk |>
  inner_join(density, by = c("geoid" = "GEOID")) |>
  group_by(city_id, acs_year) |>
  slice_max(pop, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(city_id, year = acs_year, pop, pop_density, aland_sqmi, geoid)
cat("Manual xwalk hits:", n_distinct(recover_manual$city_id), "cities\n")

density_matched <- bind_rows(density_matched, recover_city, recover_manual)

cat("Matched ACS coverage – direct:", n_distinct(density_direct$city_id),
    " + fuzzy:", n_distinct(fuzzy_density$city_id),
    " = total:", n_distinct(density_matched$city_id), "/", nrow(cities), "\n")
cat("City-year rows:", nrow(density_matched), "\n")
```

## Part B – Unemployment (BLS LAUS county-level)

```{r}
#| label: bls-download
#| cache: true
# BLS LAUS 'la.data.64.County' file contains all series, all periods.
# Annual average = period "M13". series_id starts with "LAUCN" for county unemployment rate.
bls_url <- "https://download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/la/la.data.64.County"
bls_path <- here("data", "raw", "bls", "la.data.64.County.txt")
dir.create(dirname(bls_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(bls_path)) {
  req <- request(bls_url) |>
    req_headers(`User-Agent` = "BPE thesis research") |>
    req_options(ssl_verifypeer = 0L)
  resp <- req_perform(req)
  writeBin(resp_body_raw(resp), bls_path)
}
cat("BLS file size (MB):", round(file.info(bls_path)$size / 1e6, 1), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: bls-parse
bls_raw <- read_tsv(bls_path, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
  rename_with(\(x) str_trim(x))
# Keep unemployment-rate series (measure code 03), annual (period M13), in 2014-2024
bls_annual <- bls_raw |>
  filter(
    str_detect(series_id, "^LAUCN"),    # county-level
    str_sub(series_id, -2L) == "03",    # unemployment rate
    period == "M13",
    year %in% as.character(2014:2024)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    fips_state  = str_sub(series_id, 6, 7),
    fips_county = str_sub(series_id, 8, 10),
    fips        = paste0(fips_state, fips_county),
    year        = as.integer(year),
    unemp_rate  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
  ) |>
  select(fips, year, unemp_rate) |>
  filter(!is.na(unemp_rate))

cat("BLS annual county-year rows:", nrow(bls_annual), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: city-county-xwalk
#| cache: true
# Map each recall city (GEOID, place) to its county FIPS via tigris.
# Places can span multiple counties; use the place-county relationship file.
# Simpler: use census Bureau's "place assignment" via tigris::counties intersection,
# or use the 2020 Gazetteer Places-Counties crosswalk.
# Practical shortcut: tigris::places() already has COUNTYFP but only for places
# entirely in one county. For multi-county places, use the 2020 census place-county
# relationship file.

place_county_url <- "https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/codes2020/national_place_by_county2020.txt"
pc_path <- here("data", "raw", "census", "national_place_by_county2020.txt")
if (!file.exists(pc_path)) {
  req <- request(place_county_url) |>
    req_headers(`User-Agent` = "BPE thesis") |>
    req_options(ssl_verifypeer = 0L)
  resp <- req_perform(req)
  writeBin(resp_body_raw(resp), pc_path)
}

# County Subdivision (MCD) -> County crosswalk. Same schema family as the
# Place file; covers townships, NJ/PA boroughs, New England towns, etc.,
# which the Place universe excludes.
cousub_url <- "https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/codes2020/national_cousub2020.txt"
cs_path <- here("data", "raw", "census", "national_cousub2020.txt")
if (!file.exists(cs_path)) {
  req <- request(cousub_url) |>
    req_headers(`User-Agent` = "BPE thesis") |>
    req_options(ssl_verifypeer = 0L)
  resp <- req_perform(req)
  writeBin(resp_body_raw(resp), cs_path)
}

# File: STATE|STATEFP|COUNTYFP|COUNTYNAME|PLACEFP|PLACENS|PLACENAME|TYPE|CLASSFP|FUNCSTAT
# Each place may appear in multiple counties (one row per place-county pair).
# We don't have area weights here; pick the first county listed per place.
# (For multi-county places this is approximate; documenting as a known limitation.)
pc <- read_delim(pc_path, delim = "|", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
pc_best <- pc |>
  mutate(geoid = paste0(STATEFP, PLACEFP),
         fips_county = paste0(STATEFP, COUNTYFP)) |>
  group_by(geoid) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(geoid, fips_county)

cat("Place-county crosswalk rows:", nrow(pc_best), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: unemp-match
# Join: city_id -> geoid -> fips_county -> year -> unemp
unemp_matched <- density_matched |>
  distinct(city_id, geoid) |>
  inner_join(pc_best, by = "geoid") |>
  inner_join(bls_annual, by = c("fips_county" = "fips")) |>
  select(city_id, year, fips_county, unemp_rate)

cat("Unemployment rows matched:", nrow(unemp_matched), "\n")
cat("Cities with >=1 unemp year:", n_distinct(unemp_matched$city_id), "\n")
```

## Assemble

```{r}
#| label: assemble
controls <- density_matched |>
  select(city_id, year, pop, pop_density, aland_sqmi) |>
  left_join(unemp_matched |> select(city_id, year, unemp_rate),
            by = c("city_id", "year"))

cat("Years present in controls:",
    paste(sort(unique(controls$year)), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Unique cities in controls:", n_distinct(controls$city_id), "\n")
cat("City-year rows:", nrow(controls), "\n")

controls |>
  summarise(
    cities                 = n_distinct(city_id),
    years                  = n_distinct(year),
    pct_has_density        = round(100 * mean(!is.na(pop_density)), 1),
    pct_has_unemp          = round(100 * mean(!is.na(unemp_rate)), 1),
    median_pop_density     = round(median(pop_density, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    median_unemp_rate      = round(median(unemp_rate, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Save

```{r}
#| label: save
saveRDS(controls, here("data", "cleaned", "controls.rds"))
cat("Wrote data/cleaned/controls.rds\n")
```
